The fastest hands in Bangladesh

Safwaan Mustafa is recognized as the fastest typist in Bangladesh and the fastest kid typist in the world, at 213 words per minute. He also set the national record at 176 words per minute with 98% accuracy on ATN Bangla, at the age of 13, in his early typing stages. “I consider the whole Universe to be my University.”

An AI educator who builds for a nation.

Safwaan Mustafa is a young Bangladeshi AI educator, technology entrepreneur, trainer and youth leader. He teaches AI and digital skills, coordinates young teams, and turns ideas into courses, prototypes and companies. He has reported teaching more than 20,000 students.

How he works

1 Million Ltd.

A youth-focused technology, skills and digital workforce initiative helping Bangladesh turn educated young people into a globally competitive workforce. Founded by Muhammad Yeasir, with Safwaan Mustafa as CEO. The target: empower 1,000,000 people by 2028.

Skill badges

Cloud Skills Boost, global top ten

0

As reported by 1 Million Ltd., Bangladeshi participants held all ten global leaderboard places in the 2024 and 2025 competitions. Google Cloud Skills Boost is Google's hands-on learning platform for cloud, AI and data skills, and its public leaderboard ranks learners from around the world. Safwaan is reported to have helped Bangladesh take every one of those places, and was named a Google World Champion in 2023.

What it shows

A single country filling the whole top ten, in two competitions in a row.

How it happened

Young Bangladeshis learned cloud and AI skills together, with mentoring and shared practice.

Why it matters

Evidence that Bangladeshi talent can compete at the very top, and a case for deeper collaboration with Google.

The Google ambition

Let’s build something for Bangladesh.
